content: न्यायः [नियन्ति अनेन; नि-इ घञ्] .²1 Method, manner, way, rule, system, plan; अधार्मिकं त्रिभिर्न्यायैर्निगृह्णीयात् प्रयत्नतः <ls>Ms. 8. 310</ls>; अनुक्ते हि न्याये न प्रतीमोऽर्थान्तरम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 2. 5</ls>; तस्मान्नावस्थितो न्यायः प्रत्युद्ध्रियेत <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 2. 10</ls>. ननु लिङ्गमसाधकं, न्याय उच्यतां यस्यैतद् द्योतकमिति <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 2. 30</ls>. .²2 Fitness, propriety, decorum; न्यायाधारा हि साधवः <ls>Ki. 11. 30</ls>. .²3 Law, justice, virtue, equity, righteousness, honesty; यान्ति न्यायप्रवृत्तस्य तिर्यञ्चोऽपि सहायताम् <ls>A. R. 1. 4</ls>. .²4 A law-suit, legal proceeding. .²5 Judicial sentence, judgment. .²6 Policy, good government. .²7 Likeness, analogy. .²8 A popular maxim, an apposite illustration, illustration, as दण्डापूपन्याय, काकतालीयन्याय, घुणाक्षरन्याय <ab>&c.</ab>; see Appendix. .²9 A Vedic accent; न्यायैस्त्रिभिरुदीर्णम् <ls>Ku. 2. 12</ls>. (<ls>Malli.</ls> takes न्याय to mean स्वर; but it is quite open, in our opinion, to take न्याय in the sense of ‘a system’ or ‘way’; ‘which are manifested in three systems, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} ऋक्, यजुस् and सामन्’); न्यायगर्भद्विजाः <ls>Bh. 3. 55</ls>. .²10 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A universal rule. .²11 A system of Hindu philosophy founded by the sage Gautama. .²12 The science of logic, logical philosophy. .²13 A complete argument or syllogism (consisting of five members; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} प्रतिज्ञा, हेतु, उदाहरण, उपनय and निगमन). .²14 An epithet of Viṣṇu. (न्यायेन {%ind.%} in the way of, after the manner or analogy of; बधिरान्मन्दकर्णः श्रेयानिति न्यायेन <ab>&c.</ab>).
